researched.name: JD Cables Ltd
researched.reason: NOT PUBLISHED - the best business of the four names and the weakest possible trigger, and one audited number that has to clear first. Opened the filing: a work order for 'Manufacturing, Testing, Supply & Delivery of Cables & Conductors for approx. Rs. 30.43 Crores including GST', awarded by - verbatim - 'Reputed Government & Private Entity'. The counterparty is not named anywhere in the letter or its Annexure A, so there is nothing to verify on a tender portal. Against the one order ratio the 1,245-filing study found predictive: Rs 30.43 cr incl GST is about Rs 25.8 cr ex-GST on FY26 revenue of Rs 364.59 cr (audited, from the company's own June-2026 presentation and the BSE results feed) = 7.1% of a trailing year's sales, i.e. the under-10% bucket that reached 2x 21.4% of the time, not the 25-50% band that reached it 35.7%. Rarity, measured rather than guessed: counted every 'Award of Order / Receipt of Order' filing by scrip 544524 from 2026-10-09 back two years in 90-day windows - 2025-09-26, 2025-12-23, 2025-12-27, 2026-01-12, 2026-01-19, 2026-07-23, 2026-09-15 and today = EIGHT in two years. The study's serial-announcer bucket (8+ prior filings) reached 2x only 17.3% of the time and 5x NEVER. Weakest size bucket plus serial-announcer bucket is the exact combination the study says not to buy an order filing on. What IS real, all from documents read this run: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 81.81 cr vs Rs 48.78 cr, +68% YoY (business update filed 2026-07-22); order book ~Rs 515 cr at March 2026 = 1.41x FY26 revenue, with Rs 1,000 cr+ of tenders bid (June-2026 presentation and the 04-Jun-2026 earnings call transcript); management guidance in that transcript of 50-60% revenue growth in FY27 and again in FY28 at similar 12-13% EBITDA margins, with EPC revenue going from Rs 30 cr in FY26 to 'minimum Rs 200 crores' in FY27; the new Dankuni unit (~1.18 lakh sq ft) more than doubling installed capacity - conductor division commercial production commenced 07-Jul-2026 and the cable division on 14-Sep-2026, both filed under Reg 30; credit rating upgraded by Infomerics from IVR BBB-/Stable to IVR BBB/Stable on 01-Jul-2026 with rated bank facilities raised from Rs 71.70 cr to Rs 83.00 cr; FY26 EBITDA Rs 48.11 cr (13.17%), PAT Rs 31.72 cr (8.69%), EPS Rs 14.07, ROE 21.70%, D/E 0.39, promoter 70.0% with no pledge disclosed; BSE header PE 12.86 at today's Rs 180.95, against the only same-industry peer in the site index, Systematic Industries at PE 29.68. The stock is down 25.6% in three months. The number that stops it: the FY26 annual report's audited cash flow statement shows cash USED IN operating activities of Rs 73.51 cr (FY25: Rs 18.21 cr used) against PAT of Rs 31.72 cr - working capital absorbed Rs 107.58 cr (receivables +Rs 34.71 cr, inventories +Rs 42.81 cr, short-term loans and advances +Rs 21.61 cr, payables -Rs 9.48 cr). It was funded by Rs 84.46 cr of share issue proceeds plus net borrowings; closing cash and cash equivalents at 31-Mar-2026 were Rs 0.54 LAKH. AOC-2 shows a net Rs 9.14 cr loan from the Managing Director during the year (promoter remuneration Rs 21.60 lakh, which is modest against PAT). The auditor's report is unmodified, with no qualification or adverse remark, and no going-concern matter. So every rupee of reported profit currently sits in working capital, the IPO money that plugged the gap is spent, and the stated plan is to scale EPC - the most working-capital-hungry business the company has - almost sevenfold. Verdict: researched in full and not published. It goes on the watch list with a specific, dated test rather than a view: the H1 FY27 results due in November 2026 (SME half-yearly filer) and the FY27 annual report's cash flow statement. If operating cash flow turns positive while the capacity and order book hold, the trigger that was missing today exists then.

researched.name: Shree Refrigerations Ltd
researched.reason: NOT PUBLISHED - a genuine Indian Navy order, in the smallest size bucket the study measured, from a frequent announcer, at 62x earnings. Opened all four pages of the filing. Order of Rs 7.86 crore EXCLUDING GST from the Controller Procurement Material Organisation, Mumbai (Indian Navy), for the supply of two Magnetic Bearing Compressor based AC Plants, delivery timeline 05-Oct-2027; Annexure A confirms it is a domestic award, not a related-party transaction and with no promoter-group interest in the awarding entity. Annexure B is a press note headlined 'secures fresh Indian Navy orders worth Rs. 14 crore' - read carefully, that Rs 14 cr is an AGGREGATE of 'multiple fresh defence orders... over the past one-and-a-half months', of which today's is Rs 8.25 cr including GST and the rest are spares, defect rectification and further MBC plants. The disclosed single order is Rs 7.86 cr, and that is the number used here. Size against sales: FY26 revenue Rs 153.55 cr with PAT Rs 21.40 cr (audited, BSE results feed), so Rs 7.86 cr is 5.1% of a trailing year's sales - the under-10% bucket (2x 21.4% of the time), and even the aggregated Rs 14 cr press-note figure would only be 9.1%. Rarity: the dossier's 240-day list shows SIX order filings - 18-Mar, 17-Apr, 14-May, 04-Jun, 29-Aug-2026 and today - so this is a routine disclosure cadence for a defence supplier, not a first-in-two-years event. Valuation leaves no room for a 5% order either: BSE header EPS Rs 6.01 and PE 62.00 at today's Rs 372.65 on a Rs 1,334 cr market cap, after +90.7% in six months, with promoter holding 44.6% (September-2026 shareholding not yet filed; the latest on file is March 2026). Verdict: the order is real and the Navy relationship is real; the filing is still 5% of a year's sales on 62x, which is not an idea. Watch instead for the H1 FY27 results - the FY26 print of Rs 153.55 cr already beat the Rs 140-150 cr the company guided to in February 2026.

researched.name: Onix Solar Energy Ltd
researched.reason: NOT PUBLISHED - the scan flagged this on two RESULT filings; the results themselves are a revenue collapse, and the balance sheet does not describe a manufacturer. Opened the 11-page results PDF filed at 18:59 IST (standalone and consolidated, with limited review). Q2 FY27 (quarter ended 30-Sep-2026) revenue from operations Rs 3,187.60 lakh = Rs 31.88 cr, against Rs 4,336.63 lakh = Rs 43.37 cr in the same quarter last year: MINUS 26.5% YoY. Sequentially it is worse - Q1 FY27 was Rs 9,373.56 lakh, so revenue fell 66.0% quarter on quarter. PAT of Rs 191.54 lakh (Rs 1.92 cr) against a loss of Rs 75.54 lakh a year earlier reads like a turnaround only until you see Q1's Rs 2,083.13 lakh. H1 FY27 revenue Rs 125.61 cr is +42.0% on H1 FY26's Rs 88.47 cr, entirely on Q1. The scan's own RESULT trigger therefore fails the playbook's test, which asks for revenue growth of 30%+ YoY WITH PAT growth. What the filed statements show about the business: cost of material consumed is NIL in every column and depreciation is NIL for the quarter on property, plant and equipment of Rs 707.26 lakh; the entire cost line is 'Purchase of Stock-in-Trade' of Rs 2,817.80 lakh. The note says the company deals in only one segment, 'Renewable Energy Sector Solar Module Products' - so on these numbers it buys and resells rather than manufactures. Of Rs 888.10 cr of total assets, Rs 631.64 cr are non-current INVESTMENTS and Rs 24.84 cr are loans and advances, against Rs 170.09 cr of trade receivables - and those receivables nearly doubled from Rs 90.39 cr at 31-Mar-2026 while half-yearly sales were Rs 125.61 cr. Cash and cash equivalents are Rs 4.12 lakh. Equity was raised in the half year: share capital went from Rs 2,507.02 lakh to Rs 3,686.79 lakh, i.e. 1,17,97,736 new shares of Rs 10, with reserves up Rs 71.12 cr against H1 PAT of Rs 22.75 cr - so about Rs 48.4 cr of share premium, Rs 41 per share, implying an issue price of Rs 51. An X post describing a rights issue of 1,17,97,736 shares at Rs 51 (8:17, record date 15-May-2026) matches the filed capital and premium arithmetic exactly, which is how that claim was verified; it is also 86% below today's Rs 371.95 close. Verdict: revenue down 26.5% YoY and 66% sequentially, receivables doubling on falling sales, no raw material and no depreciation under a 'solar module products' label, and a Rs 1,371 cr market cap on it. Not an idea, and the kind of RESULT trigger the scan is expected to surface and the research is expected to reject.
